blocks.text: An array has a fixed length. For data that grows and shrinks there is **`List[T]`**: `List[i32]()` makes an empty list, `push` adds, `len` is the length, `list[i]` gives an element. A list keeps its data on the heap and cleans up on its own when you are done.

blocks.prompt: Add the squares of the numbers 1 to 5 to the `squares` list and print them all.
blocks.hint: First do `squares.push(i * i)` inside `for i in 1..=5:`.

blocks.q: Which structure can grow while the program runs?
blocks.why: Arrays and tuples are fixed; `List` grows.
